title: Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Tier and Ridgeline Tool Rental Missing-Accessory Charges
content:
Holders of the upper Ridgeline Consumer Credit card tiers pay less for accessories not returned on a Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement.

> The Ridgeline Consumer Credit tier lowers the charge: when the renter's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account is active at the Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Premier tier, the charge is multiplied by 0.75; when it is active at the Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred tier, by 0.90; in every other case it is unchanged.

The multiplier acts on the accessories charged multiplied by the class charge per accessory not returned, and the rounding to the cent is made only on the final figure.

The tier and the status are those on the renter's Ridgeline Consumer Credit account record.

## Tier table

| Ridgeline Consumer Credit account | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Premier, active | 0.75 |
| Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Preferred, active | 0.90 |
| Ridgeline Consumer Credit Card Classic, active | 1 (unchanged) |
| a Ridgeline Project Loan | 1 (unchanged) |
| Premier or Preferred, suspended, closed or charged off | 1 (unchanged) |
| no account | 1 (unchanged) |

## Hypothetical figures (two accessories at 40.00, that is 80.00 before the multiplier)

| Account | Figure |
|---|---|
| Premier, active | 60.00 |
| Preferred, active | 72.00 |
| Premier, suspended | 80.00 |
